answer: One concrete defense is staking plus quadratic weighting. Every agent must lock scarce tokens as collateral, and its vote scales with the square root of that stake. A sybil wanting influence must split its funds into many identities, but each fragment is a weak vertex carrying far less sway than one honest, well-funded node. Before two agents form a bridge of trust they must attach verifiable proof of real work, so the only gale of cheap duplicates an attacker can muster burns compute and capital faster than it buys votes, making forgery strictly unprofitable.
